_about: L3 day/instant flags. Weekday 0 = Sunday. Nakshatra 1 = Ashwini .. 27 = Revati. Tithi 1..15 Shukla, 16..30 Krishna (30 = Amavasya). Rashi 1 = Mesha. Each table carries a source id from research/02-vedic-knowledge.md and its confidence tag ([P] primary, [S] two secondaries, [S1] single secondary, [M] unverified memory), or UNVERIFIED.

sarvarthaSiddhi.source: research/02 §3.3 Sarvartha Siddhi [S] dekhopanchang (Muhurta Chintamani, Nirnayasindhu); optional Tue Ashlesha / Wed Krittika 'some add'
sarvarthaSiddhi.note: cancelled by Rahu kaal (suspended), Bhadra (void), eclipse (void)

amritaSiddhi.source: research/02 §3.3 Amrita Siddhi [S] dekhopanchang (Muhurta Deepika); hindu-blog gives Wed Vishakha [CONFLICT]; exceptions [M]

siddhaVaraTithi.source: research/02 §3.3 Siddha yoga [S] dekhopanchang (Muhurta Chintamani); tithi numbers apply to both pakshas

yamaghanta.source: research/02 §3.3 Yamaghanta (vara + nakshatra) [S] Ernst Wilhelm summary; avoid especially for travel

mrityuYogaVaraTithi.source: research/02 §3.3 Mrityu yoga (vara + tithi group) [S] onlinejyotish: Sun/Tue Nanda, Mon/Fri Bhadra, Wed Jaya, Thu Rikta, Sat Purna

raviPushya.source: research/02 §3.3 [S] Drik seven-category; Pushya never for marriage

guruPushya.source: research/02 §3.3 [S] Drik seven-category; Pushya never for marriage

pushkara.source: research/02 §3.3 Tripushkara/Dwipushkara [S] dekhopanchang (Bhadra-group tithi + Sun/Tue/Sat + nakshatra); vedpanchang lists U.Ashadha instead of Vishakha/U.Bhadra [CONFLICT], dekho followed

panchaka.source: research/02 §3.3 Panchaka [S] dekhopanchang + shubhpanchang (Dharmasindhu/Nirnayasindhu); 300 deg = Dhanishtha 3rd pada, agrees with docs/ENGINE-DESIGN §5; weekday types [S], r-astro swaps Sun/Mon [CONFLICT]; North-Indian observance (UP/Bihar/Rajasthan/MP), not a bar in the South

bhadra.source: research/02 §3.3 Bhadra [S1] astrobix (attributed to Muhurta Chintamani); Drik agrees on the loka effect; only martya-loka Bhadra blocks auspicious work

gandMool.source: research/02 §3.3 Gand Mool [S] Drik gandamool page

gandanta.source: research/02 §3.3 Gandanta [P-via-Raman] jyotishkalpadrum: nakshatra gandanta = last pada of Ashlesha/Jyeshtha/Revati, first pada of Ashwini/Magha/Mula; tithi gandanta = last 2 ghatis of Purna tithis, first 2 of Nanda

yogaFlags.source: research/02 §2.1 yoga list [S] astroshastra + Raman: 6, 9, 10, 17, 27 extremely bad; Ekargala nine-yoga list adds 1, 13, 15, 19; Parigha first half bad [M]

kharmas.source: research/02 §3.5 vivaha [S]: Sun in Dhanu (mid-Dec to mid-Jan) and Meena (mid-Mar to mid-Apr); Muhurta Martanda

chaturmas.source: research/02 §3.5 [S]: Devshayani Ekadashi (Ashadha Shukla 11) to Devutthani/Prabodhini Ekadashi (Kartika Shukla 11), amanta

holashtak.source: research/02 §3.5 [S] dekhopanchang holashtak: Phalguna Shukla 8 to Purnima

pitruPaksha.source: research/02 §3.5 [S]: Bhadrapada Krishna 1 to Amavasya (amanta) = purnimanta Ashwina Krishna

sankranti.source: research/02 §3.3 Sankranti [P-via-Raman] jyotishkalpadrum: Makara/Karka 3 days either side, Mesha/Tula 1 day, others 30 ghatis (Raman 16 [CONFLICT]); punya kaal 16 ghatis after ingress [M]

eclipse.source: research/02 §3.3 Grahana [P-via-Raman] jyotishkalpadrum; sutak hours [M]; only locally visible solar eclipses count (Dharmasindhu) [M]

combustion.source: research/02 §3.5 vivaha hard blocks [S] dekhopanchang muhurta-selection, panditjionway: Guru asta 11 deg, Shukra asta 10 deg (8 deg retrograde); balya/vriddha 3 days [S]

vinchudo.source: Drik Panchang Ahmedabad 2026-11-10 lists 'Vinchudo' (Moon in Vrishchika, Gujarati custom) [S1] UNVERIFIED rule text

abujha.source: research/02 §3.5 vyapara [M] abujha (self-proven) muhurta days in North India; Gudi Padwa/Ugadi (Chaitra Shukla 1) [S]
